funding_notes: Verified domain boomsupersonic.com (Boom Supersonic / Boom Technology, Denver/Centennial CO; founded 2014 by Blake Scholl; Y Combinator alum). Building the Overture supersonic airliner, Symphony engine and Superpower gas turbines. Series A $33M (Mar 2017; company said total funding then $41M), Series B $100M (Jan 2019, led by Emerson Collective; included ~$56M new money plus previously announced strategic investments; total then over $141M), and a $300M round closed Dec 2025 led by Darsana Capital at a ~$1.5B post-money valuation (BusinessDen), which Boom's own release also calls its 'Series B'. Boom raised further undisclosed amounts between 2020 and 2024 that are not itemized by primary sources, so amount_raised is left blank (sourced rounds alone sum to $441M+ including pre-2017 seed). Airline pre-orders/deposits and turbine orders (Crusoe $1.25B backlog) are not equity. Strategic investment by Japan Airlines (2017) was part of the pre-Series B total.
